status: Acknowledged local-message candidate implemented;24 focused tests pass, including actual loopback RPC and multi-megabyte lifetime. Custom Apple-event transport failed actual runtime and was retired to Trash. Packaged CLI warm/cold followup pending.

protocol.transport: Launch the selected containing GUI app with NSWorkspace, then send versioned JSON over a public CFMessagePort named with user ID and that GUI process ID. Receiver acknowledges after queueing. Markdown remains in memory; no shared defaults, URL payloads or temporary stdin files.
protocol.source: UTF8 input only, exact BOM/CRLF/composed Unicode preserved. CLI waits for EOF for non-terminal stdin, including delayed producers. App decodes/validates off UI actor and retains an immutable initial snapshot. A fresh Untitled source is imported before ordered file requests; user edits/composition and cancellation are preserved.
protocol.files: Relative to invoking directory, ordered standardized dedup. Missing leaf files use O_CREAT|O_EXCL and normal document opening; existing files are never truncated and parent failures are reported. No implicit directory creation.
protocol.options: Preserve h/v, help precedence, boolean values, independent no-help/no-version keys and options ending at first filename. Deliberate fixes: conventional -- delimiter, and unknown leading options exit64 instead of discarding input with success.
protocol.packaging: Native arm64 helper at Snowfolio.app/Contents/Helpers/snowfolio, built by Xcode target and SwiftPM. Resolves its own containing app, including symlink invocation. No PATH links, installation or handler/default-host changes.
protocol.completion: CLI exits0 only after receiving a versioned acknowledgement from the selected GUI PID. Endpoint lookup, send and receipt are bounded by8seconds in total; cancellation and failure are nonzero. App parses/opens asynchronously and presents document errors through normal UI.

local.tests: 24 focused tests:12 CLI options/codec tests,5 real connection/lifetime/rejection/cancellation tests and7 document ownership tests. Zero compiler errors/warnings. Multi-megabyte messages remain valid after the C callback returns.
local.process: --help returns0 while stdin stays open; unknown option returns64 before app lookup/launch.
local.project: Tuist regular-host project generation passes. Standalone actual UI test source typechecks with Xcode Swift XCTest overlay. Active app bundles untouched.
